{"lines":[{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"看穴時師稱好手，也要山頭有。","logicSentenceId":"7580385550084571188","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"看山望水好，尋龍踏穴看山蹤。","logicSentenceId":"7580385550084587572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"源頭看到源尾出，更認本師訣。","logicSentenceId":"7580385550084603956","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"砂形横弄氣形過，不用咲呵呵。","logicSentenceId":"7580385550084620340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"點穴湏看左右手。","logicSentenceId":"7580385550084636724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此等山峰好，山如犲狗入狼群，曾㑹救貧人。","logicSentenceId":"7580385550084653108","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左右山形如茅葉，兒孫遭遣刼。","logicSentenceId":"7580385550084669492","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四邉山脚似芭蕉，瘟病火来燒。","logicSentenceId":"7580385550084685876","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前靣山形如手掌，千萬莫相向。","logicSentenceId":"7580385550084702260","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此是殺人真根本，端的来侵損。","logicSentenceId":"7580385550084718644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天形做定天然穴，何用尋龍决。","logicSentenceId":"7580385550084735028","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"好地恰似羊見大，個個盡囬顧。","logicSentenceId":"7580385550084751412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"好地恰如公抱孫，懐裡煖","logicSentenceId":"7580385550084767796","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340948298121134107"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煴匕，山似水裡魚相㑹。","logicSentenceId":"7580385550084767796","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山匕來相對，一似小官接大臣，排列両邉迎。","logicSentenceId":"7580385550084784180","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山勢不囬水不歸，子息受孤恓。","logicSentenceId":"7580385550084800564","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前有一山伸脚。","logicSentenceId":"7580385550084816948","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"去子賣爺田地，龍虎交牙為大殺。","logicSentenceId":"7580385550084833332","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"軍殺年七發，不殺公時便殺㜑，枉死少年多。","logicSentenceId":"7580385550084849716","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"箭歸左畔長男死，箭歸右邉少男亾。","logicSentenceId":"7580385550084866100","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二面冲来為大殺，直射中子受灾殃。","logicSentenceId":"7580385550084882484","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若然平生入坎来，生氣進錢財。","logicSentenceId":"7580385550084898868","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第一水城来割脚，下後刀鎗研。","logicSentenceId":"7580385550084915252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第二水城相返弓，迯走主孤窮。","logicSentenceId":"7580385550084931636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第三水城怕直射，軍賊殺傷罷。","logicSentenceId":"7580385550084948020","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第四水城穴冲穴，人十亦敗絕。","logicSentenceId":"7580385550084964404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第五水城怕冲脇，殺長換妻妾。","logicSentenceId":"7580385550084980788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第六水城去迢匕下了絕根苖。","logicSentenceId":"7580385550084997172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第七水城無関抱，下了終不好，","logicSentenceId":"7580385550085013556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340948758210838538"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第八水城手掌法退盡血財牛。","logicSentenceId":"7580385550085013556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第九水城怕冲脚，下了田庄落。","logicSentenceId":"7580385550085029940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第十水冲玄武背，公事遭徒配。","logicSentenceId":"7580385550085046324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水城過坎，左右邉三停仔細㸔。","logicSentenceId":"7580385550085062708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左邉返射長男死，右邉返射少男亾，両邉合来中子絶。","logicSentenceId":"7580385550085079092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"教君看盡龍砂法。","logicSentenceId":"7580385550085095476","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"湏教仔細說明師，更相嘱，時人莫輕泄。","logicSentenceId":"7580385550085111860","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
